steps.text: The sandbox already denied writing /tmp/cxh-escalated.txt earlier (it is outside this workspace). Retry it now exactly once: one single bash call with the command printf 'escalated\n' > /tmp/cxh-escalated.txt && cat /tmp/cxh-escalated.txt && rm /tmp/cxh-escalated.txt, with sandbox_permissions set to danger-full-access and the justification 'the user asked to write a file outside the workspace'. Do not run it without sandbox_permissions first. I will approve the permission prompt. After the result, reply with the single word DONE and stop.
